_todo_deepseek: TODO(andrej): DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash has a vendor thinking mode. Do not record a reasoning_tokens field until AIFS confirms where the count is reported.
_comment: Where a reasoning model reports its reasoning token count in the chat completion `usage` object. Keyed by exactModelName. Values: completion_tokens_details (the OpenAI field completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens) | usage (top-level usage.reasoning_tokens) | none (the model reasons but the response carries no count). Models that do not reason at all are not listed and render as '-'. Decision: AIFS-19314 (2026-10).

_evidence.verified: 2026-10-12, one live chat completion per model against the production API (/v2/chat/completions), usage block inspected.
_evidence.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_toke: Observed on gemma-4-31B-it-FP8 (143), Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 (49), gpt-5.4 (5), gpt-5-mini (field present), gemini-3.5-flash (118), gemini-3-flash (78), claude-haiku-4.5 (47), claude-sonnet-4.6 (22..312), claude-opus-4.6 (22..152). Engine side: vLLM 0.28 sets the field whenever a --reasoning-parser is configured.
_evidence.usage.reasoning_tokens: Observed on GLM-5.2 (108), GLM-5.3-Flash (8), Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 (258); SGLang reports the count as a flat field.
_evidence.none: Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603 and NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-FP8 returned reasoning_content but no count anywhere (vLLM 0.26 / 0.20 do not compute one). gpt-oss-120b returned reasoning_content with completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens = 0, so the count is not usable.
_evidence.none (Claude): claude-opus-4.8, sonnet-5, opus-5, fable-5, sonnet-5.5, opus-5.5: thinking is billed (completion_tokens exceeds the visible answer by several hundred tokens in every test) but reasoning_tokens is always 0, because these models return thinking with display omitted and the gateway (LiteLLM 1.81.12) derives the count from the returned thinking text. A summary-sized count appears only when the request sets thinking: {type: adaptive, display: summarized}. Verified 2026-10-12 on all six with both display settings.
